name: trip-viewer-firebase
description: Trip Viewer â€” Firebase-hosted static frontend

scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('dist/ cleaned.');"
scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "8085,9099,5000,5001,4000 | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }; Write-Host \"Killed process on port $_\" } else { Write-Host \"Port $_ is free\" } }"
scripts.dev: node scripts/dev/ensure-ports-free.js && concurrently -n fn-watch,front-watch,emulators,open -c yellow,blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "npm run watch:fast" "node scripts/dev/start-emulator.js" "node scripts/utils/open-on-ready.js"
scripts.dev:livereload: node scripts/dev/ensure-ports-free.js && concurrently -n fn-watch,front-watch,emulators,open -c yellow,blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "npm run watch" "node scripts/dev/start-emulator.js" "node scripts/utils/open-on-ready.js"
scripts.functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
